name: poker-gangwonland
description: 강원랜드 기준 텍사스 홀덤 React 프로젝트

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.start: cd backend && GOCACHE=${GOCACHE:-/tmp/go-build-cache} HOSTNAME=${HOSTNAME:-0.0.0.0} PORT=${PORT:-3000} STATIC_DIR=${STATIC_DIR:-../dist} POKER_JS_DIR=${POKER_JS_DIR:-../lib} go run .
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: node scripts/clean-e2e-coverage.mjs && E2E_COVERAGE=1 playwright test && E2E_COVERAGE=1 node scripts/exercise-server-coverage.mjs && E2E_COVERAGE=1 NODE_V8_COVERAGE=coverage/e2e/raw/engine-v8 node scripts/exercise-poker-coverage.mjs && node scripts/summarize-e2e-coverage.mjs
